problems.title: Running a PG on notebooks and WhatsApp costs you every month.
problems.p1d: Payments are spread across UPI apps, cash and chats. Nobody is sure who still owes.
problems.p2d: Rent, electricity, Wi-Fi and extras are added up by hand, every month, for every bed.
problems.p3d: One meter, many tenants, people joining mid-month. The split is often wrong and always argued.
problems.p4d: Edited, reused or fake-app screenshots look exactly like real payments.
problems.p5d: Unreported cash, unrecorded tenants and payments to someone else's UPI.
problems.p6d: Calling and messaging the same tenants every month, one by one.

how.title: Set up once. RentFlow runs every month after that.
how.s1d: Add rooms and beds in bulk, your charges, due date and UPI ID. Import tenants from Excel. About 15 minutes on a phone.
how.s2d: RentFlow drafts every bill with prorated rent and the electricity split. You review and approve with one tap.
how.s3d: Bills go out on WhatsApp, payments are confirmed with your bank, receipts are sent and reminders go only to those who owe.

billing.title: Correct bills, to the paisa, without a calculator.
billing.sub: Rent, fixed charges and the electricity meter are combined into one clear bill for each tenant.
billing.b1: Electricity split by the days each tenant stayed, so mid-month joiners pay only their share
billing.b2: Joins, move-outs, room transfers and rent changes are prorated automatically
billing.b3: Issued bills are locked; corrections are made with a credit or debit note and a reason
billing.note: Worked example from RentFlow's billing tests.

pay.b2: Reused screenshots and duplicate bank references are rejected automatically

grid.g1d: Before the due date, on the day and after. Only to unpaid tenants, with the remaining balance.
grid.g2d: PDF receipt on WhatsApp with a QR code anyone can scan to check it is genuine.
grid.g3d: Part payments are allocated oldest first; extra money becomes an advance on the next bill.

grid.g5d: Collection, outstanding dues and every tenant's ledger, ready to download.

security.title: Built so that money stays honest.
security.s1d: Tenants pay directly to your UPI ID or bank account. RentFlow only records and matches.
security.s2d: Each owner's data is separated at the database level. No one else can see it.
security.s3d: Data is hosted in India, and ID numbers are kept as the last 4 digits only.
security.s4d: We use Meta's official WhatsApp Business platform, so there is no risk of bans.
security.s5d: Managers run the day-to-day. Only you approve bills, and every payment confirmed by hand records who did it.
security.s6d: Issued bills and money records are locked. Every change leaves a trail.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.sub: Can't find your answer? Start free and look around; there is nothing to install.
faq.q1: Does RentFlow collect rent for me?
faq.a1: No. Tenants pay directly to your own UPI ID or bank account. RentFlow only records and matches payments; it never holds your money.
faq.q2: How does RentFlow know a tenant has paid?
faq.a2: You forward your bank's credit alert emails to your private RentFlow address. Every bill has a unique amount, so the credit is matched to the right tenant automatically. A screenshot alone is never treated as payment.
faq.q3: Why is my tenant's amount ₹6,500.12 and not ₹6,500?
faq.a3: The few extra paise make each bill's amount unique, so your bank credit can be matched to exactly one tenant. It is shown on the bill as a separate line and is never more than ₹0.99.
faq.q4: Do my tenants need to install anything?
faq.a4: No. Everything happens on WhatsApp: bills, payment links, receipts and reminders. The bill page opens in their browser without a login.
faq.q5: How is electricity split in shared rooms?
faq.a5: By tenant-days. If one tenant stayed 30 days and another 20, the meter cost is divided 30 : 20, and the shares always add up exactly to the meter cost.
faq.a6: Yes, on their phone. You choose which properties they see. They can record meter readings and cash and confirm UPI payments, but approving bills stays with you.
faq.q7: What if a tenant pays in cash?
faq.a7: The manager records it and the tenant gets a WhatsApp message to confirm. It counts only after the tenant says it is correct. If they say it is wrong, you are alerted.
faq.q8: Can I manage more than one PG?
faq.a8: Yes. Add as many properties as you run, each with its own rooms, charges and rules, and switch between them from the top bar.
